jobs.title: Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders)
jobs.description:
Your Mission:

We are developing a next-generation electric aircraft propulsion system, with the propulsion battery designed, developed, and validated in-house. Accurate real-time observation and prediction of the battery’s State of Function (SoF), the energy and power actually accessible for safe flight and landing, is the safety-critical output of the battery system, and the basis for pre-flight planning, in-flight energy management, and the energy information presented to the crew.

SoF is built on the underlying battery states that your algorithms observe and predict: state of charge (SoC), state of health (SoH), state of power (SoP), state of energy (SoE), and state of balance (SoB). Erroneous observation or prediction of SoF is classified as a catastrophic condition, since it can lead the crew to commit to a flight or an approach the battery cannot support. This makes the function certification-critical and places exacting demands on the accuracy, robustness, and verifiability of every algorithm you deliver.

As a Senior Battery Algorithms Engineer (all genders), you will join the VÆRIDION Technology team and take ownership of the development and validation of the state observers, estimators, and predictors that determine SoF for our lithium-ion propulsion battery systems.

This is a hands-on senior role in which you lead the modeling, simulation, algorithm development, test-data analysis, and validation behind these states, and set the methodology the team works to.

Your work will shape the high-voltage battery system at the center of VÆRIDION’s electric propulsion architecture and carry it through to certification.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Own the end-to-end development and validation of battery state observers, estimators, and predictors for SoF, SoC, SoH, SoP, SoE, and SoB across cell, cell-bank, and pack level

  • Parameterize multi-RC equivalent-circuit models (OCV, R0, RC pairs, hysteresis, thermal, and aging effects) from cell supplier data, virtual and physical test benches, and HiL rigs

  • Design, implement, and validate estimation algorithms such as Kalman filters (EKF/UKF/dual-UKF/SKF), particle filters, observers, and data-driven/ML methods, while respecting the certification limitations of ML-based approaches

  • Develop mission-aware predictors that ingest flight-profile and navigation data to predict SoF until safe landing, and compute the energy margin, the predicted surplus SoF at destination, and the SoF trend presented to the crew, updating on diversion, altitude, speed, and ambient changes

  • Develop aging and degradation models and Remaining Useful Life (RUL) prediction, and validate the SoH algorithm against the applicable end-of-life criteria across representative mission and durability profiles

  • Ensure the algorithms align with ED-289 requirements for state observers and predictors and ED-309 methodologies for energy level information to the crew, and are consistent with the “Manage Energy” functional breakdown

  • Ensure the algorithms meet functional-safety expectations for a DAL B function: deterministic and bounded execution time, reproducibility, uncertainty bounds on outputs, plausibility checks, built-in test, and malfunction and fault detection

  • Derive, document, and trace algorithm requirements from ED-289/ED-309 and system-level functional analysis, and maintain traceability into the real-time battery management software specification using a model-based design approach

  • Support the real-time embedded realization of estimators and predictors on the pack, lane, and central control units (fixed-point implementation, Simulink code generation, MISRA C) and validate them on HiL setups

  • Define the test and analysis strategy for virtual and physical battery test benches and HiL rigs, and analyze cell, cell-bank, and pack-level data to evaluate algorithm accuracy, stability, and robustness across temperature, aging, and usage variability

  • Set the standard for documentation of methods, assumptions, and validation results

  • Lead collaboration with cell engineering, BMS software, test, HV/LV electrical systems, and certification teams

 

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Control Engineering, or a related field

  • 5+ years of professional experience in battery state estimation, control systems, or embedded algorithm development

  • Strong command of state estimation and control theory: Kalman filtering (EKF/UKF/dual-UKF/SKF), particle filters, observers, and system modeling, with an awareness of data-driven and ML methods and their certification constraints

  • Solid battery domain knowledge: lithium-ion electrochemistry, equivalent-circuit and thermal models, aging and degradation mechanisms (capacity fade, resistance growth, lithium plating), OCV hysteresis, and cell-bank-level state granularity

  • Proficiency in Matlab/Simulink and Python, with familiarity with C/C++, fixed-point implementation, Git, and CI/CD

  • Experience with real-time simulation, HiL testing, and embedded systems

  • Familiarity with aerospace functional safety and certification: DO-178C/ED-12C and the DAL concept, requirements-based verification and validation, MBSE and model-based design, and relevant battery and energy standards (ED-289, ED-309, DO-311A, SAE AIR6897); DO-160 environmental awareness is a plus

  • Analytical mindset, strong attention to detail, the ability to own deliverables end-to-end, and clear technical documentation skills

Your Mission:

Join VÆRIDION on our journey to develop the world's first electric nine-seater aircraft. As a PCB Layout Engineer (all genders) in our Technology division, you will own the physical design of the printed circuit boards at the heart of our high-voltage propulsion battery and power-distribution systems, turning engineering intent into flight-ready, manufacturable and certifiable hardware. Partnering closely with our electronics, hardware and manufacturing engineers from schematic to fabrication, you will apply IPC standards and aerospace-grade design discipline to hardware that must be safe, reliable and light enough to fly - work that directly underpins the propulsion battery system at the core of our mission to bring electric flight to regional aviation.

  • Design, route and iterate multilayer PCB layouts from schematics, netlists and engineering requirements.

  • Define and document PCB stack-ups, controlled-impedance geometries and reference-plane strategies together with the hardware engineers.

  • Perform ECAD–MCAD co-design with the mechanical team, including STEP exchange, board-outline and keep-out definition, and connector and component placement against enclosure and thermal constraints.

  • Apply high-voltage layout discipline - creepage and clearance, isolation barriers and 3W spacing - in line with IPC-2221 and the demands of aerospace high-voltage battery systems.

  • Engineer for signal integrity, power integrity, EMI/EMC, manufacturability and thermal management, using thermal vias, heavy-copper and metal-clad constructions.

  • Create and govern the PCB component library — schematic symbols, footprints and 3D models - in accordance with IPC standards.

  • Ensure designs comply with IPC-2221, IPC-7351 and IPC-6012 (including Class 3 expectations for high-reliability hardware) and other relevant IPC standards.

  • Produce complete fabrication and assembly data packages: Gerbers, ODB++/IPC-2581, drill files, BOMs, pick-and-place and assembly drawings.

  • Perform design rule checks (DRC), electrical rule checks and layout-versus-schematic verification, and support design and readiness reviews.

  • Collaborate with electronics and hardware engineers to implement design changes and resolve layout issues.

  • Minimum of five years of hands-on experience in PCB layout or electronics design support.

As VP Finance (all genders) at VÆRIDION, you will build and lead the financial backbone of a capital-intensive deep-tech aerospace scale-up. You will drive financial steering, ensure strong finance hygiene, and lead financing and fundraising activities to support our transition from development to industrialization.

You will work closely with the executive leadership team and act as a key strategic partner across engineering, manufacturing, and business functions. A strong focus of this role lies on structuring and executing asset financing, venture debt, development credits, and fundraising activities in a dynamic, high-growth environment.

 

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Own company-wide financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes. Establish scalable financial governance, reporting standards, and KPI frameworks.

  • Build scalable finance processes, tools, and systems supporting the transition from startup to industrial manufacturing organization. Partner closely with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Program Management, and Business teams to support data-driven decisions.

  • Structure and execute asset financing solutions for equipment, tooling, and production assets. Lead structuring and negotiation of venture debt and development credit financing. Build and manage relationships with banks, debt providers, and financing partners.

  • Support equity fundraising processes including financial modeling, investor materials, and due diligence. Own financial data rooms, investor reporting, and financing-related analysis.

  • Support building and developing the finance function as the company scales. Act as sparring partner for executive leadership on financial strategy, risk, and capital allocation.

 

Your Profile:

  • Around 10 years of experience in Finance, Corporate Finance, Structured Finance, Investment, or similar. Experience in at least one startup, scale-up, or fast-growing dynamic environment is strongly preferred.

  • Proven experience in capital-intensive industries such as deep tech, aerospace, manufacturing, hardware, energy, or mobility.

  • Hands-on experience in at least two of the following areas: Asset financing, Venture debt, Development / innovation credits, Project financing, Equity fundraising support

  • Strong financial modeling and scenario planning skills. Experience negotiating financing structures and term sheets. Understanding of manufacturing cost structures and CapEx planning.

  • Experience with public funding landscapes in Germany or the EU is a plus. Experience in regulated or certification-driven industries is a plus.

  • Strong ownership mindset with ability to operate strategically and execute operationally.

  • Ability to work in ambiguous and fast-moving environments.

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills in English; German or another European language is a plus.

jobs.description:
About Hiya

At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective.

Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve.

Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes.

This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed.

Account Executive (Berlin, Germany)

Berlin | Hybrid (3 days in office)

The Company

Hiya is building the future of trusted voice.

We help businesses improve customer engagement and protect users from spam and fraud through AI-powered voice intelligence. Our technology supports hundreds of millions of users globally, working with leading telecom and technology partners.

Up to 90% of unidentified outbound calls in Germany go unanswered.

If you’re selling into the German market, you already know how difficult it’s become to connect with customers.

Hiya is solving this. Through branded caller ID and verified voice, we help businesses improve answer rates and customer engagement. We partner with Samsung, Deutsche Telekom, Vodafone and O2—reaching the majority of mobile users across Germany.

The Role

We’re hiring an Account Executive to drive new business for Hiya Connect in Germany. You’ll own the full sales cycle from pipeline generation through to close, working closely with SDRs and marketing to build and convert opportunities.

This is a high-impact role in a fast-growing SaaS business, with strong ownership and clear revenue responsibility.

What you’ll do

  • Own and close new business opportunities in the German market

  • Build and manage pipeline in partnership with SDRs and marketing

  • Run discovery, demos, and tailored solution presentations

  • Engage senior stakeholders across sales, operations, and CX

  • Consistently hit and exceed ARR targets

  • Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM discipline (Salesforce)

  • Work cross-functionally with Customer Success and Product

What we’re looking for

  • Experience in B2B SaaS sales with full-cycle ownership

  • Strong track record of closing new business

  • Comfortable operating in a high-growth environment

  • Structured, disciplined approach to pipeline and forecasting

  • Fluent German and English

What you can expect

  • Clear ownership and autonomy in your territory

  • A product solving a real, visible problem

  • Collaborative, execution-focused culture

  • Opportunity to grow with a scaling international business

More Details

When determining compensation, a number of factors will be considered: skills, experience, job scope, location, and competitive compensation market data.

Trusted by global leaders like Canva, HubSpot, Tripadvisor, Bosch, and Deutsche Telekom, we’re building the retrieval infrastructure layer for modern AI. Recently raising $50M in Series B funding, we are growing rapidly and committed to transforming how AI understands and interacts with data.

As a remote-first company, we believe diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences fuel innovation. Here, you’ll own meaningful work, tackle challenges, and grow alongside passionate individuals dedicated to shaping the future of AI.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will work on the core cloud platform that enables all other engineering teams at Qdrant. You’ll design and evolve shared services, control-plane components, and internal APIs that power our managed cloud offering and support enterprise-grade deployments.

This role is about building platform primitives and abstractions, not day-to-day operations. You’ll focus on reducing complexity, improving developer productivity, and driving architectural evolution across the cloud platform.

What you will own

  • Design and evolve core platform services and internal APIs consumed by multiple teams.

  • Drive architectural initiatives such as gRPC migration, eventing/pub-sub foundations, and platform refactors.

  • Own and improve control-plane and cluster-api components.

  • Build platform abstractions that reduce operational and cognitive load for other teams.

  • Write production-grade Go code for platform services and internal tooling.

  • Collaborate closely with Regions & Clusters, Resilience, and Features teams to enable delivery through platform primitives.

  • Improve platform scalability, reliability, and developer experience through thoughtful design.

  • Support production systems and incident response when needed, with a focus on long-term fixes.

Who you are

  • 5+ years of experience as a software engineer working on platform, infrastructure, or distributed systems.

  • Strong proficiency in Go and Python, or deep expertise in one with willingness to work regularly with both.

  • Solid experience with Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures.

  • Strong understanding of distributed systems and API design.

  • Experience building and operating production systems used by other engineers or teams.

  • Comfortable working cross-team and driving technical alignment.

  • Ownership mindset and clear communication skills.

Nice to have

  • Experience with gRPC, event-driven architectures, or control-plane systems.

  • Familiarity with Kubernetes operators or cluster-level abstractions.

  • Background in SaaS, database, or systems-level product companies.

  • Experience with observability tooling (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry).

  • Contributions to open-source projects.

Why join us

  • A remote-first, international team working on cutting-edge AI infrastructure.

  • A competitive salary with additional perks.

  • Flexible working hours and async-friendly culture.

  • High ownership and real impact.

  • Open-source, engineering-driven culture.

  • Choose your own laptop equipment.

For US-based full-time employees, we also offer a comprehensive benefits package including 401k match, health, dental, and vision insurance, plus flexible PTO policy.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineering Lead
jobs.description:
About Comena

Comena builds AI agents for industrial distributors and manufacturers to automate their order processing from e-mail inbox to ERP. At distributors across the US and Germany alone, there are 4 million sales and procurement people stuck in manual workflows between inbox and ERP. We want to automate this work and liberate these people to work on more meaningful things.

We’re part of the YC S25 batch - the most selective batch in YC history. We recently raised a seed round from top Silicon Valley investors, and are serving customers across US and Germany.

 

About the role

Comena is delivering seven-figure deployments for leading industrial companies across the US, UK and the EU.

As our Forward Deployed Engineering Lead, you will own the bridge between our product, engineering team, and customers, defining how Comena is implemented and scaled across organizations.

You will be responsible for ensuring customers successfully adopt Comena, creating scalable processes for implementation, and helping our engineering team move faster by turning customer learnings into clear technical requirements.

This is a high-ownership role combining customer success, engineering, and operational excellence. You will work closely with customers to understand their workflows, coordinate deployments with engineers, identify recurring implementation challenges, and build the systems that allow us to onboard customers faster as we scale.

Key responsibilities

Customer onboarding and deployment ownership: Lead the full customer implementation lifecycle, from initial discovery through successful production rollout. Own customer onboarding processes, coordinate deployments, and ensure customers successfully adopt Comena’s AI platform. Work closely with customers to understand their workflows, data, and systems, and collaborate with engineers to deliver reliable solutions.

Deployment strategy and process building: Establish the processes, playbooks, and best practices that enable faster and more consistent customer deployments. Identify bottlenecks in onboarding and work with engineering and product teams to improve tooling, documentation, and workflows that make future FDE deployments more efficient.

Cross-functional collaboration: Act as the bridge between customers, founders, and engineers. Translate customer needs and operational challenges into clear technical requirements, coordinate engineering efforts, and ensure alignment between customer expectations and product capabilities.

jobs.description:
Job description

We are currently seeking a Data Engineer for our international and diverse Climate Policy Team (CPT). The team is engaged in various projects on climate change mitigation, in particular on energy system transformation, the 1.5°C global warming limit and the evaluation of national climate action. This includes flagship projects, such as the Climate Action Tracker and the National Pathways Explorer, for which data is being processed and analysed in-house and then published on the respective project websites.


As a Data Engineer you will play a critical role in designing, building and maintaining our data infrastructure, ensuring efficient and accurate data processing, storage and retrieval. 


Your Responsibilities

  • You will help to build and maintain a data platform for advanced analytics and climate modelling, spanning data science and data engineering work.

  • Contribute to the full lifecycle of data platform development from design and deployment to continuous improvement

  • Strengthen data pipelines reliability, observability, and automation through code and tooling improvements.

  • Collaborate with data scientists and researchers to define data processing requirements.

  • Support AI/LLM initiatives across the organisation from a data and infrastructure perspective.

  • Help develop backend data services and APIs that expose curated datasets to internal and external consumers and applications.

  • Monitor, anticipate, and resolve operational or data quality issues in data pipelines. Ensure data reliability.


Relevant Tech Skills

Please note that this list is non exhaustive and that if you don’t have experience on some of those you should still apply.


Required:

  • Python

  • SQL

  • PostgreSQL

  • Object storage (like S3/Minio)

  • Containers (like Docker)

  • Git

  • CI/CD principles


Nice to have:

  • Pandas/Polar/DuckDB or other framework for data processing

  • Conda

  • Monitoring tools (like Prometheus, Grafana and Elasticsearch)

  • Infrastructure as code tool (like Terraform or Ansible)

  • AI‑driven productivity tools


Your profile

You will ideally have the following qualifications and skills: 

  • You have a bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, ideally with a specialization in Data Engineering or DevOps, or a related field.

  • You have gained initial experience as a Data Engineer in a production environment.

  • Foundational notions in data modeling, data structures, algorithms, design patterns, optimization.

  • Familiarity with the relevant tech skills mentioned above.

  • Basic understanding of data pipelines, APIs, or backend services.

  • Exposure to data engineering in the context of Agentic AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Business Intelligence across different types of data formats (structured vs unstructured) and processing methods.

  • Passionate about working at the intersection of Climate Science and Data Engineering (tell us about relevant projects you’ve worked on!).

  • A problem solver, a fixer, and a creative technologist. We believe coding is a talent and a passion, not just a skill.

  • A strong communicator and a team player who can work efficiently with others, in a diverse, interdisciplinary and international team.

  • Exceptional time management in a complex and largely autonomous work environment.

  • Good communication skills in English


Our offer

  • A job with a purpose. You will work in an international team of highly engaged people and contribute to our work in the field of climate change mitigation

  • A positive and inspiring working atmosphere in an international team. Our Berlin office is located near Moritzplatz in the heart of Kreuzberg

  • Hybrid office policy and flexible start time

  • Fully funded Germany-wide public transport ticket

  • 40 € monthly company contribution to Urban Sports Club membership

  • Online mental health and wellbeing platform

  • Free German language classes

  • Bike rental discount

  • Optional company pension plan


Conditions

  • Application deadline: Open until filled

  • Start date: As soon as possible

  • Duration: We are looking for a long-term collaboration. Currently we can offer a fixed term contract for 12 months with the perspective of extension based on performance and funding.

  • Remuneration: The range is EUR 4,363 (Masters plus 5+ relevant years outside of university studies) to EUR 4,810 (9+ years relevant experience outside of Masters'), in accordance with level 4 steps 1 to 3 of our remuneration scales

  • Vacation: 29 days paid annual leave for each year worked (pro rata) + one day gifted around Christmas.

jobs.description:
Your mission

YOUR MISSION
As Director, Strategic Operations, you will act as a force multiplier for our CEO and executive team. You will turn strategy into clear priorities, decisions and measurable execution, while creating the governance and transparency that help our leadership focus on the opportunities with the greatest value for Matrix42.

Your key responsibilities would look like this:

  • Own and continuously improve our leadership operating system and governance cadence across ExCo, XLT, leadership forums and strategic offsites.
  • Drive agenda planning, decision tracking and follow-through, ensuring clear ownership and timely escalation of risks, bottlenecks and cross-functional dependencies.
  • Lead the annual planning process together with Finance and functional leaders, translating company goals into coherent functional plans and measurable targets.
  • Track strategic priorities and value creation initiatives across the organization, creating visibility on progress, milestones, dependencies and execution risks.
  • Increase CEO effectiveness by preparing executive meetings, customer engagements, strategic discussions and leadership communications, and by coordinating resulting actions.
  • Coordinate high-quality materials, reporting and follow-up for the Board of Directors and our private equity sponsor.
  • Strengthen organizational alignment through clear executive messaging, visibility of company priorities and more efficient, AI-enabled ways of working.


Your profile

YOUR PROFILE

Must Have

  • At least 7 years of experience in business operations, executive office, transformation, program management, consulting, Chief of Staff or a comparable leadership-adjacent role.
  • A strong track record of managing complex, cross-functional initiatives and working closely with executive leadership teams.
  • Excellent planning, organizational and program management skills, combined with disciplined follow-through and a strong execution focus.
  • Strategic judgement and the ability to understand business priorities quickly, connect strategy with execution and influence without formal authority.
  • Analytical and financial fluency, including confidence working with financial models, KPI packages and board-level information.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex information into clear, decision-ready executive materials and presentations.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken, high ownership and sound judgement when handling confidential and sensitive information.
Nice to Have
  • Experience in a SaaS, software or technology environment.
  • Experience with Board or private equity sponsor preparation, reporting and governance.
  • Fluency in German.
  • Experience improving leadership productivity through AI-enabled tools and efficient operating rhythms.


Why us?

This is a high-impact role at the center of Matrix42's leadership and strategic execution. You will work directly with the CEO and executive team, shape how priorities become action and create the operating discipline behind our continued growth. The role offers broad exposure across the company, Board and sponsor environment, with the mandate to build alignment and make execution more effective without owning a business unit or operational function.


Our Benefits

We could tell you about the free breakfast, the drinks in the fridge, and the 30 vacation days. Or that flexible hours and remote work are part of the deal. But honestly? That's just standard.

Hybrid work is a natural part of how we operate, but we also believe in the power of coming together. That's why we regularly connect in the office whenever it makes sense. And that's just the beginning. Ask us what else is waiting for you!


Your contact person

Send us your application, including your salary requirements and earliest possible starting date, directly through our online portal via the "Apply for this job" button. If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact Patrick Ziegler.

jobs.title: Senior People Ops Manager (International)
jobs.description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We've raised Series B funding and reached 300+ million users worldwide, processing over 5 billion images annually and serving both small businesses and major enterprises like Amazon, DoorDash, and Decathlon through our mobile app, web platform, and API.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

The role

We are looking for a Senior People Operations Manager to own and improve the systems, processes and operational foundations behind our People function, across all of our markets.

You will own the core People Operations scope: payroll, HRIS, contracts, compliance, benefits, employee lifecycle operations, immigration, people data and our HR tooling. But this is not simply a role about running existing processes - your job is to make them better. You will build the people workflows, automation, documentation and self-service mechanisms that allow Photoroom to keep moving quickly as we grow, without creating unnecessary complexity.

This scope has so far sat within a small generalist People team. You will be the first person to own it as a dedicated senior scope, giving you the opportunity to shape this operating model.

We are also an AI-native company, and we want our People function to operate the same way. We expect you to actively use automation and AI to improve speed, reliability and employee experience, while maintaining a high bar for privacy, compliance and trust.

You will report to our VP People. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports today.

Why this role exists

We have built a lot quickly. Today, our People Operations environment includes:

  • French and USA payroll and entity obligations

  • European employees through an EOR setup

  • Growing Paris and New York offices

  • Multiple benefits providers and external partners

  • An HR technology stack that has grown alongside the company

The foundations work. Now they need a clear owner and regular improvements.

We want to move from processes that depend on individual knowledge and manual intervention to an operating model that is documented, automated, measurable and more self-service for our employees.

Your goal is to strengthen our foundations with proven best practices and build a model that scales comfortably with the company.

What you will own

Payroll

  • Own and Run monthly payroll for France and our European population, and twice-monthly US payroll, working closely with our external providers

  • Manage relationships with payroll, EOR and employment providers

Compliance

  • Maintain our French statutory obligations and HR compliance calendar, including employee records, social declarations, DUERP and employee data requirements

  • Own the operational administration of our CSE, including convocations, agendas, meeting preparation, PV review, annual budget administration and mandatory timelines

  • Monitor relevant employment law developments and translate changes into concrete actions

  • Coordinate compliance across our European and US setups, with deep expertise expected in France primarly

Contracts and People documentation

  • Employment contracts, amendments, offer letters, attestations and standard HR letters, maintaining and improving templates as our organisation and legal environment evolve

  • Setting clear service levels for recurring People Ops requests

  • Building practical People playbooks and documentation that employees and managers can actually find, understand and use

Employee lifecycle

  • Onboarding administration from signed offer through day one, coordinating payroll, benefits, declarations, IT access, equipment, manager actions ect..

  • Offboarding and exit administration, including documentation, payroll, benefits, access removal and final employment documents

  • Promotions, compensation changes, employment changes, contract amendments, leaves, parental leave and other employee changes

  • Immigration and visa administration, including external providers, applications, renewals and deadline tracking

Benefits & Compensation

  • Administer benefits and manage providers across France, Europe and the US

  • Run annual renewals with Finance and the VP People, using cost, usage and employee value to inform decisions

  • Support compensation benchmarking and salary band maintenance

HRIS, data and automation

Our HRIS is Hibob today, which may or may not change. You will own the reliability and evolution of our People systems.

This includes:

  • HRIS configuration, permissions, workflows, integrations and data quality

  • Making the HRIS the reliable source of truth for employee data

  • Assessing opportunities to consolidate or improve our HR technology stack

  • Automating repetitive workflows wherever doing so improves speed and reliability

Employee support

You will help us move from a People team that repeatedly answers standard questions to one that builds systems people can use themselves.

You will build the documentation, workflows, processes and self-service infrastructure that make the majority of standard People requests easy to solve without intervention, while personally handling the exceptions and escalations that genuinely require expertise.

What we are looking for

You have already owned a meaningful People Operations scope in a fast-moving company of +100 employees.

In particular, we are looking for:

  • Hands-on experience with French payroll and employment compliance

  • Experience owning People Operations processes, workflows, and controls

  • HRIS experience. Hibob is a plus, but experience configuring and improving a comparable system matters more

  • A systems mindset and a strong instinct for automation

  • Excellent operational judgement. You know which issues you can solve yourself and which require specialist advice

  • High standards of accuracy, discretion and follow-through

  • Comfort operating independently in a small team where you will both design the process and run it

  • Fluent French and English. English is our working language, while much of our payroll and employment law environment is French

  • Based in Paris and able to work from our office at least three days per week.

The person who will thrive here likes that combination: build it, simplify it, automate it and own it.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging

We're committed to enabling everyone to feel included and valued at work. We believe our company and culture are strongest when composed of diverse experiences and backgrounds.

That's also why we have flexible working hours, trust people to work remotely, and extended parental leave.

All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, family, gender identity, marital status, national origin, physical or mental disability, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws.

jobs.title: Chef(fe) de projet déploiement solution SAAS
jobs.description:
Qui sommes-nous ?

N2JSoft est une fintech B2B SaaS spécialisée dans la digitalisation des processus RH et financiers, qui développe deux solutions : N2F et Vertical Expense.

Vous serez amené(e) à travailler plus particulièrement sur Vertical Expense, notre solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais qui accompagne les entreprises et les organisations publiques dans leur transformation digitale.

Notre mission : simplifier, automatiser et sécuriser la gestion des frais professionnels, tout en nous adaptant aux besoins et aux contextes parfois complexes de nos clients. Notre solution est très personnalisable, hautement interopérable, et déployée auprès de structures exigeantes, souvent multi-populations (collaborateurs nomades, agents, intérimaires, prestataires externes…).

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Pour accompagner le développement de nos projets et répondre aux besoins de nos clients, nous renforçons notre équipe Consulting. Nous recherchons un(e) Chef(fe) de projet déploiement pour piloter l’implémentation de la solution Vertical Expense chez nos clients, en collaboration avec les équipes internes (technique, produit, CSM) et les interlocuteurs client (DSI, DAF, DRH, métiers).

Tu interviendras au cœur des projets, de la compréhension des besoins, au paramétrage de la solution, en passant par l’accompagnement des utilisateurs.

Tes responsabilités :

  • Piloter les projets de déploiement de A à Z, du cadrage à la mise en production.

  • Analyser les besoins des clients et les conseiller sur l’optimisation de leurs processus.

  • Animer les ateliers projet et assurer la coordination des différentes parties prenantes.

  • Rédiger et faire valider les spécifications fonctionnelles et les livrables projet.

  • Organiser et réaliser le paramétrage de la solution selon les règles métier du client.

  • Accompagner les intégrations techniques (connecteurs ERP/SIRH, SSO, API…)

  • Assurer les phases de tests, recettes, formations, et transfert vers les équipes support.

  • Contribuer à l’amélioration continue de nos processus de delivery.

  • Être un relais actif du retour client vers les équipes produit.

  • Assurer le suivi des projets et garantir la satisfaction client.


Ce qu’on va attendre de toi :

  • Tu as une expérience réussie en tant que chef(fe) de projet fonctionnel ou consultant(e) fonctionnel(le) dans le cadre d’un projet de déploiement (Solutions Finance, RH, ERP ou SIRH... est un plus).

  • Tu maîtrises les bases de données et SQL, et tu comprends les environnements web, API, SSO et formats d’échange.

  • Tu possèdes un bon niveau fonctionnel, notamment sur les sujets de comptabilité, frais professionnels et processus métier.

  • Tu es à l’aise dans les projets multi-interlocuteurs et sais adopter une posture de conseil fonctionnel auprès des clients.

  • Tu es organisé(e), rigoureux(se), réactif(ve) et communiques avec aisance à l’écrit comme à l’oral.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre ?

  • Rejoindre une entreprise en croissance, avec une base clients qui se développe et des contextes d’utilisation variés.

  • Évoluer dans un environnement stimulant, où ton expertise et tes actions auront un impact concret sur la réussite des projets et la satisfaction client.

  • Travailler autour d’un produit reconnu et apprécié par ses clients.

  • Rejoindre une équipe expérimentée et bienveillante, favorisant le partage de connaissances, tout en développant ton expertise fonctionnelle grâce à des missions variées et un rôle clé dans l’accompagnement de nos clients.

Processus de recrutement

  1. Entretien téléphonique RH.

  2. Première mise en situation : découverte d’une solution SaaS de gestion des notes de frais et échange autour de ses fonctionnalités.

  3. Seconde mise en situation (en autonomie) : cas pratique de paramétrage sur un environnement de test.

  4. Échange avec la Head of Delivery, le Project Manager et RH (1h).

Poste basé à Aix-en-Provence, rémunération : 45k à 50k€ brut annuel selon le profil.

jobs.title: Experienced / Senior Fullstack Engineer (Productivity)
jobs.description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.


Le contexte
 
La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout.
Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.
 
Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur :
1. Analyse de documents
2. Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques
3. Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation
 
C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.
 
Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !
 
A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)

Les missions 🛠
  • Concevoir et développer des features produit de bout en bout — de la modélisation back-end à l'interface utilisateur, en ownership complet sur tes sujets.
  • Intégrer des modèles d'IA et LLM dans les flux produit — pour enrichir l'expérience des avocats et juristes qui utilisent Doctrine au quotidien.
  • Maintenir et faire évoluer notre architecture cloud — stack moderne, scalabilité, fiabilité des services en production.
  • Participer activement aux choix techniques de ta squad — revues de code, décisions d'architecture, amélioration continue de la qualité du code.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit et Design — pour transformer des problèmes métier complexes en solutions techniques concrètes et utiles.
  • Contribuer à la roadmap technique transverse — outillage, dette technique, documentation, et montée en compétences collective.

    • Le profil idéal 👀
  • Tu maîtrises TypeScript/JavaScript côté back et front, et tu es à l'aise sur une stack moderne en production (Node.js, React ou équivalent).
  • Tu as une vraie culture backend — modélisation de données, APIs robustes, performance, gestion de la dette technique. Le front ne te fait pas peur, mais c'est le back qui te définit.
  • Tu es autonome et orienté ownership — tu prends un sujet, tu le cadres, tu le livres. Tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire.
  • Tu travailles bien avec le Produit — tu comprends le besoin utilisateur, tu sais challenger un spec, et tu penses impact avant technologie.
  • Tu as une appétence pour l'IA — tu n'es pas forcément expert LLM, mais tu t'y intéresses activement et tu vois comment ça transforme les produits.
  • Tu aimes partager et faire grandir les autres — revues de code constructives, documentation, pair programming. Tu laisses la codebase meilleure qu'à ton arrivée.

    • Les à côtés du poste 👁
  • Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverse, en l’espèce le chapter Web. Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour :
  • 🤝 Partager des connaissances : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques,…
  • 🎯 Proposer des évolutions : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre
    •  
  • Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻 recrutement : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens.

    • Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝

    • Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
    • Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
    • Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
    • Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.

    Nos valeurs 🤝

    Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.

    • Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
    • Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
    • Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
    • Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.
     

    Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

    🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

    🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

    🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

    🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

    📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

    🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

    🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

    💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

    🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

     

    Notre processus de recrutement 🚀

    • Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
    • Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
    • Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
    • Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.

But International Fintechs and non-US banks are left with two unsatisfying options to access it: Either they build on legacy clearing banks that are slow and unreliable, or they interface with middleware providers that don’t move and hold the dollars directly, but themselves rely on underlying legacy banks. Augustus collapses this stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.

We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

You're a super IC in a small, elite engineering team. You work on core banking systems and own projects end to end. You take on big projects, drive them yourself, and deliver.

You work with engineering, product, and clients. You turn complex financial problems into clean code. You're trusted with the big calls from day 1; system design, technical tradeoffs, what we build and what we don't. The team is small on purpose, that means you have a lot of ownership, you move fast, and you make decisions that actually matter.

You're part of the product engineering team building the Programmable Bank - a bank for the new age of money movement, built around Digital Assets and AI. Your team builds the banking core across bare metal central bank infrastructure and blockchain infrastructure. We're building a Swiss clock: your job is precision engineering, translating a complex system into simple, clean code that runs reliably at scale.

Understand the codebase and increase your ownership rapidly.

  • Months 1-2: You ramp up fast. Understand the codebase, the domain, the product and ship meaningful code in your first weeks. Pick up a major project as an IC and start driving it. You're pairing with the team but operating independently early.

  • Months 3-4: You've shipped your first big project end to end. You know the domain well enough to push back on product decisions when something doesn't make sense. You're starting to influence technical direction - how we model data, how we handle edge cases, where we take shortcuts and where we don't.

  • Months 5-6: You're one of the people the team relies on for the hardest problems. You scope and drive projects autonomously. You have strong opinions on how the core banking systems should evolve and you're acting on them. Junior engineers come to you because your code is clean and your thinking is clear.

  • Set The Bar: You're harder on yourself than anyone else would be. You don't need external accountability to care about quality.

  • Shape The Game: You don't wait for a playbook and you don't need one. You walk into genuinely new territory and figure it out. You move before anyone asked you to.

  • Systems First: You don't solve problems by adding people or effort. You build systems that make the problem smaller. Your first instinct is to automate, not to handle it manually.

This role is for you if:

  • Your former teammates would put you in the top 5% of engineers they've worked with - your code is clean, correct, and easy to delete.

  • You merge your PR today, not tomorrow. You ship and iterate rather than wait for perfection.

  • You want to build core banking systems that handle real money, not another CRUD app.

  • You care about simplicity more than cleverness.

  • You'd rather own a problem end to end than wait for someone to hand you a spec.

  • You want to work alongside people who are genuinely great at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You think that a new fancy pattern or architecture principle will solve all your problems.

  • You think "that's not my problem" is an acceptable answer.

jobs.title: (Senior) Technical Field Engineer — Robotics Integration & Deployment
jobs.description:
🚀 Join SE3 Labs as (Senior) Technical Field Engineer — Robotics Integration & Deployment

Be the person who makes advanced autonomous systems work in the real world. Move across the full stack: drones, sensors, calibration, autonomy software, perception, networking, payloads, field operations, and partner environments. When the system is not mission-ready, you create clarity, find the root cause, and help make it robust.

 

About SE3

SE3 Labs is building Spatial AI by combining 3D computer vision with large language models. We believe the ability to reason about and act within physical space is foundational to unlocking the next generation of automation, from construction to smart infrastructure, and ultimately, defence.

Now, we’re bringing Spatial AI into the sky through high-performance UAVs that can perceive, localize, coordinate, and act in the real world. This requires more than strong algorithms and good hardware. It requires systems that can be configured, calibrated, tested, deployed, demonstrated, debugged, and improved under real field conditions.

We’re looking for a hands-on engineer who wants to work close to the product, close to the field, and close to the full autonomy stack. Someone who is not limited to one layer, but follows the problem wherever it leads.

 

About the Role

As (Senior) Technical Field Engineer — Robotics Integration & Deployment, you will own the last mile between SE3’s engineering team and real-world use. You will bring together UAVs, payloads, sensors, onboard compute, autonomy software, operator tools, and partner environments into systems that are ready to fly, test, demonstrate, and deploy.

This is a highly hands-on, full-stack field engineering role. When something is not working, you go where the evidence leads: recalibrate a sensor, solve an issue in the perception stack, debug a radio link, inspect a harness, analyse a flight log, adapt an autonomy behavior, fix a configuration issue, improve a checklist, or bring the right evidence back to the engineering team.

The problems you will work on are complex, dynamic, and multivariable. You will often have partial information, limited time, imperfect tools, and a system where hardware, software, environment, and operator behavior interact in non-obvious ways. Your job is to create clarity, choose the right debugging path, and drive the system toward a robust long-term solution.

You will work closely with perception, robotics software, embedded, hardware, and flight-test teams. You will not just operate systems; you will make them better. Your work will determine how quickly SE3 moves from prototype to repeatable deployment, from demo to product, and from individual systems to operational fleets.

 

What You’ll Work On

  • Create Clarity in complex situations: Separate symptoms from root causes, know when to trust intuition and when not to, devise efficient debugging workflows, reproduce failures, analyse logs, and drive lasting solutions that make the system more robust long term.

  • Cross-Stack Engineering: Move across hardware, software, sensors, calibration, perception, networking, autonomy, and operator workflows. When the root cause requires it, contribute directly to the layer that matters, from sensor calibration and deployment configuration to perception-stack behavior, autonomy logic, networking, or hardware integration.

  • Autonomy & System Integration: Bring together UAVs, payloads, onboard compute, cameras, IMUs, radios, ground stations, autonomy software, operator interfaces, and deployment tooling into field-ready systems. Configure and validate perception-stack behavior, mission logic, autonomy behaviors, operator workflows, and system responses under real operating conditions.

  • Tooling, Automation & AI Workflows: Build and use intelligent debugging, analysis, and agent-based workflows to understand complex system behavior faster. Improve scripts, checklists, dashboards, log pipelines, diagnostics, configuration tools, and deployment workflows.

  • Testing & Acceptance: Define and run acceptance tests for platforms, payloads, software releases, and deployment configurations. Own readiness checks across calibration, software flashing, networking, sensors, and pre-mission setup. Make readiness measurable, repeatable, and hard to fake.

  • Fieldability Ownership: Spot design flaws, integration gaps, recurring failure modes, and process bottlenecks. Turn field evidence into better hardware, software, procedures, and product decisions.

  • Field Service & Deployment: Install, configure, maintain, and support SE3 systems at test ranges, customer sites, partner demonstrations, exercises, and real-world deployments. Make sure our autonomous platforms perform reliably where it matters.

  • Partner & End-User Interface: Demonstrate systems to partners and end users, support training, translate field feedback into engineering requirements, and represent SE3 with technical credibility outside the lab.

     
 

Your Profile

  • Most importantly, you’re structured, fast-moving, and mission-driven. You don’t wait for perfect information. You create clarity, iterate fast, and prefer finding and fixing root causes over applying patches.

  • You hold a B.Sc., M.Sc. PhD, technical apprenticeship, military technical training, or equivalent practical background in Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, Mechatronics, or a related field.

  • You bring hands-on experience integrating, testing, operating, or troubleshooting complex robotic, UAV, embedded, automotive, industrial automation, or defence systems.

  • You are comfortable moving between hardware and software: Linux systems, sensors, radios, flight controllers, payloads, power systems, mechanical interfaces, networking, and operator tools.

  • You can read logs, inspect telemetry, use a command line, run scripts, flash devices, debug configurations, trace network issues, and communicate findings clearly.

  • You are not afraid of real hardware and field constraints. You use the right tools, inspect connectors, diagnose wiring or power issues, work with lab equipment, and stay systematic when the problem is messy.

  • You enjoy working directly with partners, operators, and end users. You can explain technical problems clearly, build trust in stressful situations, and represent SE3 professionally outside the lab.

  • You are proactive, hands-on, and willing to travel for field tests, partner demonstrations, and deployments across Europe and other strategic markets.

  • You speak fluent English; German is a strong plus. A driving license is required. Given the nature of SE3’s work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to work on defence-related projects and, where required, obtain the relevant security clearance.

     
 

Especially Valued Bonus Skills

  • Experience with ROS2, Docker, Linux, edge compute devices, C++/Python, Bash, Git, or deployment automation.

  • Experience with UAVs, PX4, ArduPilot, QGroundControl, Mission Planner, MAVLink, flight logs, mission planning, and airspace coordination.

You will develop and deploy the algorithms that let our platforms estimate motion, maintain pose, build spatial understanding, and operate reliably in degraded or GPS-denied environments.

You will work across visual-inertial odometry, SLAM, sensor fusion, calibration, time synchronization, mapping, and real-time systems. Your work will sit at the center of our autonomy platform: connecting cameras, IMUs, GNSS, onboard compute, control systems, payloads, and Spatial AI models into a coherent understanding of the world.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You will design algorithms, write production code, analyze logs, debug sensor issues, validate performance in simulation and flight, and work closely with robotics software, embedded, hardware, and field teams to turn perception research into fieldable capability.

 

What You’ll Work On

  • Robustness in difficult conditions: Improve state estimation capabilities in very difficult field conditions during heavy rain, snow, fog, in the night, under strong vibration, motion blur, imperfect calibration and sensor degradation. Compare improved sensor fusion and learned methods using recorded data and field results.

  • VIO & State Estimation: Build, tune, and deploy robust visual-inertial odometry and state-estimation pipelines for robotics systems operating in dynamic, outdoor, and GPS-challenged environments. Initial focus is on UAVs, but we want to build algorithms that work well for any robotics system.

  • Sensor Fusion: Fuse and synchronize data from cameras, IMUs, magnetometers, barometers, and other onboard sensors into reliable pose, orientation, uncertainty estimates, and spatial context for downstream autonomy.

  • SLAM & Re-localization: Build mapping, loop closure, re-localization, and map-based navigation capabilities that let our systems maintain spatial understanding across missions, environments, and degraded sensor conditions.

Your Profile

  • You take ownership of a problem from diagnosis through implementation and validation. You work quickly, investigate root causes and use measured results to decide what to improve next.

  • You hold an M.Sc., Ph.D., or equivalent practical background in Robotics, Computer Vision, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field.

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Foundational Data Science
jobs.description:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

What you'll do

This role is foundational data science: building the foundations of tabular foundation models so a single model can solve data-science problems across the board. Roughly half the work is inventing new frontier tools for TFMs, and half is building the dataset and benchmark bedrock they stand on.

  • Invent and build the frontier tools that extend TabPFN, including its thinking, scaling, and agentic capabilities, and the new methods that let one model generalize across the full landscape of data-science problems. This is the most open-ended part of the work and grows over time.

  • Set the research direction by deciding which model capabilities and benchmarks are worth pursuing, choosing what is worth solving rather than optimizing a score someone else set.

  • Bring in external research and real customer needs to shape new model and tooling directions, and publish frontier results that move the field forward.

  • Build trustworthy benchmarks from the structured data behind real, high-impact problems, so the team optimizes for real-world performance rather than one leaderboard.

  • Faithfully implement the baselines and competitor models that set the gold standard of applied data science, giving the team a read on where TabPFN leads and where there is room to improve.

  • Build an automated, agentic pipeline with a human in the loop so this data and benchmark foundation scales to far larger volumes without losing rigor, itself a genuinely new tool.

What we're looking for

  • You have solved data-science problems across many domains and datasets to a high standard, optimizing for strong performance across a whole suite of tasks rather than the single best score on one.

  • You work undogmatically across the ML toolbox, including getting strong results with gradient-boosted trees (such as XGBoost) and not only with deep learning.

  • You understand the common categories of dataset defects (leakage, label noise, distribution shift, duplication, mislabeled targets, and similar) and why each corrupts a training or benchmark signal.

  • You are energized by foundational work, valuing the dataset and benchmark bedrock as much as the frontier tooling, and you have taken on hard problems others passed over.

  • You thrive as a senior individual contributor in an ambiguous, early-stage, low-process environment. You are opinionated on best practice in Data Science and can make good judgement calls on approaches to complex problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience building or extending evaluation harnesses, benchmark suites, or experiment frameworks that others rely on.

  • Experience building LLM- or agent-assisted pipelines with a human in the loop to scale a previously manual workflow.

  • Experience acting as the link between external research or customer needs and an internal model or product roadmap.

  • Prior work on tabular, structured-data, or foundation-model problems, or helping shape an emerging research subfield through community work.

Life at Prior Labs

You'll work alongside researchers and builders who hold themselves to a very high bar - in the quality of their work and in how they work with each other. We move fast and still take the time to do things right.

Our teams are based in Berlin, Freiburg, and New York - when you're working on something as hard as TabPFN, being in the same room matters. But great people come from everywhere, and in exceptional cases we're open to remote, which usually means frequent travel to one of our offices. Wherever you're based, the whole company comes together regularly for offsites to build and celebrate together.

Our Commitments

The best products and teams are built by people with a wide range of perspectives and backgrounds. We welcome applications from all identities and walks of life - especially if you've ever felt discouraged by "not checking every box" - and provide equal opportunities regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disability, or any other trait that makes you who you are.

jobs.title: Associate Product Owner
jobs.description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we're looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.
You write specs worth acting on.
The valuable ones pull three threads together: where the product is going, what clients are actually telling us, and the knowledge already sitting in the team. You gather all three before you write, so what lands on the board is specific enough to build and pointed enough to matter.
You know what looks good.
You have a great sense of design and what feels good for users. We will ask you to build a prototype with AI and illustrate the specs visually.
You have worked somewhere small enough that there was nowhere to hide.
No layers between you and the consequences of a bad spec.
You want to be coached hard.
Direct feedback, weekly, on your actual work. You will scope alongside the product lead until you are doing it alone, and the goal is that this happens fast.
You are fluent with AI tooling, day to day.
We want to see the workflow, not hear it described.
You want the scope to grow.
The people who do best here end up owning areas outright: the major initiatives, the roadmap arguments, and the questions everyone else brings their doubts to. That is earned, and it is genuinely available.


What you'll do

Your job: turn validated opportunities into work an engineer can start on Monday.

  • Turning opportunities into scoped, sequenced, estimable work: specs, acceptance criteria, edge cases, dependencies
  • Running the backlog: grooming, prioritisation input, keeping the board honest about what is in flight, blocked, or quietly drifting
  • Being the interface between customer signal (support threads, CS conversations, call notes) and the engineering queue
  • Coordinating releases and checking that what shipped matches what was scoped
  • Presenting product decisions to varied stakeholder groups, from engineers to enterprise clients

What you'll be scoping over your first year:
  • Deep integrations into our customers' organisations. Their systems, their data, their identity stack. This is the work that turns GlassDollar from a tool people visit into infrastructure they run on.
  • Public REST APIs and MCP servers, so our customers' engineers and their AI agents can build on top of us.
  • AI embedded across the product, inside the surfaces people already work in.
  • Workflow automation inside the platform, so the work that used to take six meetings and a shared spreadsheet runs itself.
You will need to understand each of these well enough to write the spec and defend it in the room.
This is a doing role rather than a people-management one. Mid-to-senior individual contributor.


Requirements

  • 3+ years in a product company, where you personally wrote the tickets
  • Technical enough to understand a data model, an API contract, and estimation
  • Demonstrable writing ability, be ready to share a spec, PRD or decision doc
Nice to have:
  • B2B enterprise SaaS background
  • Familiarity with venture clienting, corporate innovation, or startup-scouting workflows
  • Notion fluency

Don't check every box? Apply anyway. We care more about the questions you ask about a brief than the answer you land on.


How we hire

Straightforward. Respectful of your time. No mystery steps.

  1. Intro call: a quick chat to see if there's a match
  2. Interview with the PM, including a brief introduction to the work sample: a spec, PRD, or decision doc where your reasoning is visible, plus examples of problems you've framed
  3. Interview
  4. Offer: if it clicks, we don't wait around

  • Share results in a way the rest of Tandem can act on.


You are the right fit for the role if you:

The benefits


Passion for languages:

Take a deep dive:

Teams who train together, stay together:

It takes a team to Tandem: 

Bonding with our teammates outside of our normal work routine is important to us. We organize regular team events: from day trips to monthly lunches, summer BBQs, and movie nights.


Balance matters: 

Life isn’t just about work. We know when to snooze Slack notifications, recharge our batteries, and take time out for our personal hobbies. As home office has become the new normal for some of us, it’s even more important to be able to switch off from work and relax.


Modern family: 

As part of our family-friendly company philosophy, we embrace flexible working hours, welcome families to our events, and love for our kids to visit the office and get a taste of life at Tandem.


Relocation without the stress: 

If you’re looking to relocate to Berlin, we’re ready to assist you with the infamous German bureaucracy. Many of us have been through it before, so we have plenty of tips to share. You’ll feel settled in no time.


Hybrid by design: 

We’re all about embracing a flexible, modern way of working. That’s why we focus on a hybrid approach—balancing time between our vibrant Berlin-Mitte office and the comfort of your home.
